changelog:
- Initial release of the remember-projects skill.
- Tracks project status, milestones, owners, and blockers for proactive risk management.
- Enables live project reporting and tracking via the BlueColumn API.
- Provides endpoints to open, update, and recall project details.
- Designed for agents managing ongoing work needing a real-time overview.
summary: A project memory that tracks status, milestones, owners, and blockers so nothing stalls silently. Use when an agent manages ongoing work and needs a live picture of every project. Requires a BlueColumn API key (bc_live_*).
